title: Altair OptiStruct workflows and connector status
description: Explore Altair OptiStruct workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.

Altair OptiStruct

Altair OptiStruct supports structural analysis and design optimisation.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Define a baseline structure

Begin with the idealised geometry, material assumptions and analysis scope. In the intended Altair OptiStruct preview, define a baseline structure; the visible result is a solver-ready model view with mesh regions and constraints exposed. Review units, connectivity, mesh suitability and model assumptions before accepting or exporting it.

Configure optimisation responses

Use the selected load cases, contacts and solution controls. In the intended Altair OptiStruct preview, configure optimisation responses; the visible result is a configured analysis state with loads and boundary conditions visible. Review load paths, restraints, convergence controls and applicable codes before accepting or exporting it.

Review a manufacturable concept

Start from the completed result set and acceptance quantities. In the intended Altair OptiStruct preview, review a manufacturable concept; the visible result is plots or tables that connect response values to the model. Review convergence, sensitivity, units and engineering reasonableness before accepting or exporting it.
